changelog:
#### ✨ ميزات وتحسينات رئيسية:
- feat(updates): integrate direct GitHub Cloud release discovery and auto-update stream
- feat(updates,theme): finalize offline release engine, update toolbar notifications, and lock #170c5c primary brand color
- feat(settings): polish system updates section and restore full width settings pages
- feat(sidebar): polish collapsed sidebar layout, uniform icon sizing, and tooltips
- feat(products,pos): align basic info grid to 3 columns and integrate quick add product modal in POS
- feat: add POS partial payment support and interactive customer & supplier ledger with expandable invoices breakdown
- feat(settings-hr): optimize general settings, backup grid, tax integration 2-col dashboard, and multi-session quick attendance
- feat(pos): enhance quick service workflow, shortcuts (F3/F6/F8), held drafts UI, and wheel scrolling

#### 🐛 إصلاحات واستقرار النظام:
- fix(layout): resolve content cut-off on sidebar collapse in RTL and improve password rotation gate
- fix(ci): resolve architecture guardrails and catalog item type alignment for green pipeline
- fix(core): harden manufacturing, maintenance, import and hr audit modules with e2e master suites
- fix(attendance): allow checkOutAt when employee is already checked in and refine shortcut action
- fix(pos): enable smooth mouse wheel scroll for cashier products grid and remove 12-item cap
- fix(dashboard): align negative treasury sign to right and remove live synchronized badge
- fix(reports-cashdrawer): enhance date range filtering, shift reviews, and report endpoints
- fix(treasury): ensure expenses created during open shift correctly reflect in cash drawer and fix datetime input timezone offset
